name: Announcement — bold
description: A loud, confident notice: a huge headline on a strong colour, a short paragraph, a footer line and an optional QR code for the details. For closures, deadlines and anything people must not miss.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. Shown top left.

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: A short label above the headline, e.g. REMINDER or NEW. Capitals read best.

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline
params.help: The announcement in a few words. Up to 40 characters; it takes two or three lines on screen.

params.name: body
params.label: Details
params.help: One or two sentences. Press Enter for a new line.
params.default: The building is closed all day for scheduled electrical maintenance. Please work from home; the IT help desk stays open on extension 4400.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.help: Who it is from, a date, a room or a contact.

params.name: show_qr
params.label: Show a QR code
params.help: Turn off if you have no link: the code and its caption disappear.

params.name: qr_url
params.label: QR code link
params.help: The address the QR code opens. Shorter links make a code that scans from further away.

params.name: show_date
params.label: Show today's date
params.help: The screen's live date, in the language and timezone below.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Date timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language the date is written in, e.g. en-GB, de-DE or fr-CA. Leave empty to use the screen's language.
